text:
Maya (People Ops): quick q — we're booking an Airbnb for a 3-night offsite in SF for four people. One person wants to charge on their personal card and get reimbursed. What's the minimal docset we need?

Devon (Backend): i can book on personal card if that's easier. do we need separate receipts per person or can i submit one and note the split?

Ravi (Finance): you can submit one expense, but we need the booking confirmation (pdf/email) showing dates and total, plus the payment method (credit card statement page or last4). also need the cost split in the expense notes.

Maya (People Ops): add: if the total is over $750 you need manager pre-approval and CCing people-ops on the request. For standard weekend offsites under $750, manager approval at submission is fine.

Devon (Backend): how about cleaning/service fees + Airbnb service charges? are those reimbursable?

Ravi (Finance): yes, they're reimbursable as part of lodging. but we prefer a host invoice that breaks line items. if the booking UI only shows one lump sum, include the booking page screenshot and the confirmation PDF. we'll accept that.

TravelBot: Reminder: attach receipts as PDFs or legible images. Expenses > $100 require itemized receipts. For shared bookings, include a short CSV in the expense description (e.g., "+devon:325,+zoe:325,+rachel:325,+mike:325").

Zoe (Manager): also note policy: if you're claiming per-diem for meals, don't also submit meal receipts for the same day. choose per-diem OR actuals.

Devon (Backend): ok — one more: who gets reimbursed? the person who paid?

Ravi (Finance): yes — reimburse to the payer. We won't split reimbursements across multiple employees in one transaction. If you want others reimbursed separately, have each person submit a small transfer request or Venmo reimbursement proof attached. But simplest: payer gets full reimbursement and they settle outside of payroll.

Maya (People Ops): i'll pin a mini checklist in #travel: 1) prefer company card; 2) if personal card used attach confirmation + proof of payment; 3) include split math in notes; 4) manager approval required if >$750; 5) pick per-diem or actuals.

Devon (Backend): thanks — i'll book and upload confirmation + split note when i submit.

Ravi (Finance): perfect. tag me on the expense if it's borderline and i'll fast-track it.

Maya (People Ops): great — thanks everyone! :party:
